descricao: The Muted Lake is an eerily still, lifeless body of water that maintains a frigid temperature regardless of the warmth of the surrounding level. Further reports on the lake have documented a strange metallic smell emanating from it. When within an, as of yet, unknown radius of the Muted Lake, as its name indicates, all forms of vocal communication become extremely difficult. The lake acts as a black hole of sorts for it, “siphoning” any sort of sound into its depths.
